_readme: This is the one file to edit for wording, links, sizes and switches. Keep the quotes and commas as they are. showDates must stay false until Andy says otherwise. podLink: once the show is on Apple Podcasts, paste the link here and every Listen button switches to it. home.sectionOrder: drag-free reordering, just move the names (substack is the latest written post, under the dispatch player). sections.videos.enabled: true turns the video section on. comingSoon.pitch and comingSoon.ctaLabel are the landing page's one ask (the line over the email field and the button; the field hands the address to Substack per signup.mode); comingSoon.note is the small line; comingSoon.aboutText is what the About button shows when hovered (blank hides the button). signup.mode picks how the email fields hand people to Substack (see signup._note). countriesFade times the country outlines fading in and out over the route. plan.tabGids lets the Route plan button open the current segment. home.odometer / home.timeTravel switch the phase 3 interactions on and off.

site.name: No Shortcuts
site.description: A bike trip from Deadhorse, Alaska to Ushuaia, Argentina. 543 days, 18 countries, no shortcuts.

signup._note: mode "subscribe" opens Substack's subscribe page with the email already filled in (one more tap there). mode "direct" posts the email straight to Substack's own free-signup endpoint, the one its embed form uses. Try direct with your own email once; switch back if Substack ever shows an error page.

countriesFade._note: The country outlines over the route, on the landing page and the home banner: each fades in secondsIn long, secondsBetween apart north to south; all hold secondsHold, fade out over secondsOut, rest secondsOff, repeat. on: false switches it off.

home._milesCompare: The MILES view's infographics: each is a label, the length of one (miles, or feet for small things), an icon (globe, runner or person) and 'each', how many one drawn icon stands for (the globe draws one big globe with the lap as an arc instead). people holding hands: 5.2 ft each, the average adult arm span (about 5.6 ft fingertip to fingertip) less the overlap where two hands clasp.

milesCompare.label: people holding hands in a line

map._note: The full map page. tiles: the map behind the route, any standard {z}/{x}/{y} tile address (blank = no tiles, the plain drawing instead). tint keeps the tiles in the site's colours. zoomNear is the closest the map comes when following the route (7 = a whole region, 10 = a town); long days zoom out from there, up to zoomOutMax levels, so the whole day fits.
map._geocoder: Looks up a place that is not on the plan (free OpenStreetMap service, no key, used only when someone asks). Blank switches it off: those searches then just say 'not on the route'.
